additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401477-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multiple] Request for FW update CRM:01410001408
additional_info.body:
Hello Marnic Segers,
We were able to update most of the chargers to the latest FW 6.0.3 for the date 28/01/25, however some chargers could not be updated:
Attached screenshot shows the status.
For chargers at MA-074-Wilrijk
→ rCOT8t, the charger was offline before we began the FW update
→91u1SM, while updating the charger, it went offline on SCB. We are unable to determine the root cause for the charger to go offline, hence we request you to intervene the charger on site. We also request you to have the Sicharge companion tool available before you go on site. Also, please carry a spare router and a working SIM card for troubleshooting, if the issue is found to be of SIM or router.
For chargers at MA-227-Hoboken
→oFsZJo, while updating the charger, it went offline on SCB. We are unable to determine the root cause for the charger to go offline, hence we request you to intervene the charger on site. We also request you to have the Sicharge companion tool available before you go on site. Also, please carry a spare router and a working SIM card for troubleshooting, if the issue is found to be of SIM or router.
For chargers at MA-272-Rotem
→ YFhA3D, the charger was offline before we began the FW update
We will continue with our update schedule for 29th and 30th.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shreyas Sathe
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
